notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content:
We’ve overhauled the Haunted Bloodlines demo to bring it much closer to our vision for the final game. Here’s what’s new:

New Gameplay Mechanics – Defend yourself against certain enemies for added strategy and suspense.

Smarter AI – Enemies now react more intelligently, making encounters more intense.

Graphics Rebuilt from Scratch – Almost every asset is brand-new, exclusively for Haunted Bloodlines.

Performance Boost – Faster load times, smoother gameplay, better optimisation.

Atmosphere Upgrade – Improved lighting, haunting effects, and enhanced physics.

Cleaner UI – More intuitive and immersive interface.

New Modes – Photo Mode to capture chilling moments, plus Light Mode.

Localization – Multi-language support is now available.

Bug Fixes – Squashed issues for a smoother experience.

This update is a major step toward what Haunted Bloodlines will be at launch, more immersive, more intense, and more haunting than ever.

🖤 Try the new demo and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Major Optimization Demo Update 0.1.2
notes.content:
We’re excited to share the latest changes with you! This update brings several new features and fixes to enhance your experience, including:

New Features and Fixes:

 Added Feedback button
 Quit Question in the pause menu
 New background animation in the pause menu
 Tutorial hint added for sanity flickering lights
 Fixed lighting issue in the opening puzzle clue
 Resolved player clipping issues with ceilings
 Added piano cap close sound
 Fixed clock sound issue when moving hands with the controller
 Optimization improvements
 Graphics overhaul for better visuals
 New gameplay elements
 Fixed inventory transparency issue
 Additional environment sounds for more immersion
 Updated sanity system
 Added new cupboard decorations
 Fixed enemy behavior bugs
 Additional room decorations
 Updated loading screen with helpful hints
 The traffic lights puzzle bug was fixed and improved with smoother animations


Next & Final Update (Coming Soon):
Looking ahead, we’re already preparing the next and final update for the demo. Here’s what you can expect:

 Localisation support
 Further optimization for an even smoother experience


Important Notes:
Please be aware of the following important details related to this update:

 Caution: Previous save files may not work due to new gameplay content added in this update.
 Known Issue: Only Xbox One controllers are currently supported. Using other controllers may cause bugs. If this happens, disconnect the controller and restart the game or your computer to fix the issue.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.1 Haunted Bloodlines
notes.content:
Thank you so much for the support for our recently release Demo version, we're sharing with you the update we launched last night.

Fixed all copyrighted tracks for the game and everything is now copyright free and licensed.
Sanity is now decreasing faster.
Small tweaks on performance and bug fixing.

The next update will focus on optimization and bug fixing.

Thank you,
Horrified Triangles
